svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Stand: Stand with soft knees and both dumbbells just in front of your thighs.
svg.title: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Stand: Stand with soft knees and both dumbbells just in front of your thighs.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Hinge: Push your hips back and let the dumbbells travel close to your legs.
svg.title: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Hinge: Push your hips back and let the dumbbells travel close to your legs.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Stretch: Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch and can still keep your back steady.
svg.title: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Stretch: Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch and can still keep your back steady.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Stand up: Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
svg.title: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift, Stand up: Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
